title: Stasis Devil Motorcycle
description: A surreal painting depicts a red devil riding a flaming motorcycle through a swirling blue vortex filled with lightning, eyeballs, stars, and floating mouths. In the background, monstrous black skyscrapers with screaming faces and sharp teeth tower over the scene, with text elements 'STASIS', 'JLX3', and '#J5E6E6' overlaid.
prompt: A surreal dark artwork shows a red devil with horns riding a black motorcycle emitting flames and lightning, speeding through a large blue circular vortex containing eyeballs with fire trails, stars, and screaming mouths. Above, monstrous black skyscraper buildings with giant toothy mouths and angry eyes loom against a red and black background, with dripping yellow text STASIS, purple JLX3 sign, and a blue street sign #J5E6E6, in a chaotic graffiti painting style.
medium: digital painting with acrylic and spray paint textures
